title: 第14章 我感觉我很强！
content_zh:
柳艳没有带李皓去刘隆的办公室。
而是左拐右拐，最终进入了执法大楼的地下室，还是其他人进不去的地下室区域。
地方很大，李皓一进门，就觉得有些空旷，但是很安静。
安静的有些渗人。
在执法大楼，还能让人感觉毛骨悚然，这地方，显然不一般。
进门区域，摆放着大量的锻炼器材。
而墙壁上，也和柳艳办公室一样，挂着大量的兵器。
热武器和冷兵器都有。
刀枪剑戟，样样俱全。
至于热武器，李皓甚至看到了一门个头不小的小型火炮，看的李皓头皮真的有些发麻，我的天，这些家伙到底囤积了多少兵器？
执法队就是有优势。
哪怕刘隆这地方被人查到了，也没什么关系，他是执法队长，银城的暴力机构老大，他说这些武器都是为了对付歹徒，那也没人能挑出毛病了。
若是李皓敢囤积这么多武器，那早就被人抓起来枪毙了。
在健身区和武器库前方，还有一条小小的通道，好像通往其他区域。
柳艳并未带李皓进去。
进入健身区，柳艳大声喊道：“老大，人来了！”
片刻后，几道人影从深处走出。
人高马大的刘隆，瘦若竹竿的吴超，胖的走路都有些震动的一个男人，还有一个个头娇小，看起来面善，年纪不算大的女人。
加上柳艳，刚好五人。
这就是执法队中的猎魔小队。

尽管这个季节很热，刘隆依旧是风衣在身，大部分原因还是为了遮掩那浑身上下挂满的兵器，否则带着那么多兵器出门，谁都能看出问题。
“刘隆！”
刘隆跨步而来，脸上的冷色不减之前，却是再次自我介绍了一次：“猎魔小队队长，负责正面攻坚！”
瘦弱旗杆的吴超也幽幽笑道：“吴超，猎魔小队侦查员，负责情报搜索，以及侧面吸引火力！”
胖的惊人的大胖子，声音憨厚笨重，也自我介绍：“陈坚，猎魔小队盾防员，负责防守！”
那娇小个头的女人，声音也很柔和，“云瑶，猎魔小队的医生，负责治疗。”
四个人，不同的职位，不同的职能。
分工很明确！
人虽少，却是五脏俱全。
李皓看了一眼柳艳，这位又负责什么？
柳艳巧笑如烟，见李皓看来，娇笑道：“看什么？柳艳，猎魔小队副队长，副攻手！老大是主攻手，我负责补刀！”
李皓了然。
刘隆看向李皓，平静道：“我们就是猎魔小队的全部人员！以前人更多一些，现在……少了许多，就我们几个了！”
“如今，小队只有主攻副攻手两人，医生、盾防、侦查各一人。”
他看向李皓，沉声道：“李皓，你愿意加入我们吗？”
李皓点头。
刘隆深深看着他，“李皓，你可知，我们为何叫猎魔小队？”
李皓没说话。
刘隆自问自答，“因为……我们是正义！”
这一刻，李皓甚至有些恍惚，看着眼前几人，我们……是正义吗？

刘隆声音冷漠，却是带着不容置疑：“我们就是正义！也许，我们有各自的目的，各自的心思，但是，你别忘了，我们是巡检司执法队！我们是执法机构，我们伸张正义，我们守护银城，我们所做的一切，一方面是为了保护自己，强大自己，一方面也在维护和平！”
“我们所猎杀之魔，都是那些干扰凡尘，手染鲜血的刽子手！”
“李皓，加入我们，第一件事就是忘记其他，谨记一点，我们便是正义！而那些犯错的超能者，便是魔，只是巡夜人无法清理，便由我们代劳，负责清理掉这些污秽！”
加入猎魔小队的第一时间，刘隆便开始为李皓灌输小队的使命。
或者说，这是猎魔小队的队章！
一支各怀鬼胎的小队，对他们而言，显然是极其危险的，因为他们对付的敌人，都超乎想象。
所以，这个人数不多的小队，其实有自己的信念或者说信仰。
伸张正义！
不管真假，他们都笃信，自己是正义使者，正在为银城驱赶魔头。
“正义……”
李皓喃喃一声。
刘隆声音严肃无比：“不错！正义！李皓，伤无数，成为很多超能者的后花园，任取任夺！”
“当然，此刻的你，未必当真，未必相信！然而，你出去走一走，看一看，偌大的世界，城池数百上千，而今，除了中部，四面八方，早就乱了套，乱世已经到来，人命如蝼蚁！”
“一位超凡现身，可能就会霍乱一城！唯我银城，这数年来，安居乐业，虽有骚乱，却是一直太平！猎魔小队成立五年，猎杀超能者五人，一年一人，每一次，都在拯救银城！”
柳艳站在李皓身边，抱着双臂，闻言笑嘻嘻道：“老大说的不错，虽然老大有些喜欢吹嘘，可此话不假！我们加入猎魔小队，的确各有心思，也许本来目的并非为了保护谁，可事实就是如此，因为我们的存在，银城才得以安居乐业！”
李皓若有所思。
也许，刘隆说的不算错。
他们猎杀超能者，也许是为了让自己超凡，也事实上，他们可能也猎杀了一些准备霍乱银城的超能者。
外面，很乱了吗？
李皓不知。

因为他几乎没离开过银城，说几乎，那是因为以前倒是去过一次隔壁的城市，但是也是很多年前了。
“李皓，这是你入队，我给你上的第一课！”
刘隆语气中带着森然：“不要觉得我们是暗中行事的鬼魅之辈，错，我们是执法者，是维护、伸张正义的使者！所以，对我们而言，凡是犯错的，都是魔！猎魔猎魔，猎的便是这些魔！”
李皓听闻此言，忽然有些放松的感觉。
哪怕刘隆的话，有些自夸，有些自我攻略的意思。
可是，当刘隆说出，我们才是正义，才是执法者的时候，李皓忽然觉得……很舒服。
就是莫名的觉得舒服！
我们不是暗中行事的阴险之辈，我们是整座城市的守护者，尽管初衷未必如此，可事实摆在这。
这一刻，李皓愈加觉得，刘隆是个高手。
不单单是实力、心思上一流，关键在于，对方连思想上的指导，都很厉害。
他让每一位猎魔小队的成员，都笃信自己所做的一切都是正义。
没有负罪感！
杀了超能者，也只会觉得有成就，是保护人民，保护正义，守护银城。
这种心理上的满足，是一般领导无法做到的。
而刘隆，居然还在这方面有建树。
这一刻，李皓觉得，加入猎魔小队，也许真是个不错的选择。
而就在此刻，刘隆沉声道：“李皓，介绍一下你自己！”
李皓想了想，开口道：“我叫李皓，原机要室巡检，银城古院退学生！我擅长五禽术中的猿术，动作较为敏捷。”
“没了？”
刘隆看着他，李皓有些窘迫：“没了。”

刘隆冷冷道：“就这样，你便成了袁硕的关门弟子？”
李皓有些尴尬：“那是老师抬举。”
“李皓，在这，如果你没有足够的价值，遇到了危险，我们不会放弃你，但是，不会冒着生命危险去救援你！如果你有足够的价值，哪怕我们牺牲了，也会换你活着，让我们的信念，一直持续下去！”
李皓沉默一会，又补充道：“我还擅长古文字解析，古文明探索中，古文字解析是重要一环，我记忆力很强，这是我优点之一。”
几人你看我，我看你，眼神都有些异样。
古文字解析！
有用吗？
很大作用！
袁硕如今地位崇高，就因为他是古文明探索系主任，身份不是关键，关键在于，袁硕也是古文明资深大家，对古文明的研究，极其深入。
所以，哪怕巡夜人，也很仰仗他。
但是，巡夜人不敢让袁硕成为超能者，因为一旦袁硕成为超能者，那会有很多麻烦发生。
有些东西，普通人无用，但是对超能者作用很大。
可往往，超能者又没有足够的知识和见解，去辨认那些对他们有用的东西。
袁硕可以！
普通人的袁硕，不敢私藏，不敢私吞。
可一旦袁硕成了超能者，那很可能会不受控制，一旦发现一些宝物，他极有可能私吞，而且还是在所有人不知道的情况下私吞掉。
此刻，刘隆眼神微微一亮！
“你得到了袁硕几分真传？”
李皓谦虚道：“队长太高估我了，老师的知识，浩瀚如海，我不过是汲取其中一滴水罢了。”
“说人话！”

“……”
李皓无奈，只好道：“我在古院只跟了老师两年，主要都是学习，并未参与一些实践。老师擅长的东西太多，如今我只是钻研一些古文字解析，其他能力远不如老师，老师擅长太多，比如陷阱破解、古物保存、风水定位、古文明人文……”
说起袁硕，李皓也是感慨不已，望尘莫及，叹息道：“我离开古院后，忙于其他，也没时间再去学习，老师的本事，我真的是望尘莫及！”
刘隆沉声道：“已经很不错了！能被袁硕看上，就代表了你的天赋和本事！”
古文字解析……
他没再多说这个，很快道：“那好，李皓，从今日起，你就是猎魔小队的情报分析员兼……诱饵！”
“……”
场中无声。
诱饵，也是能兼职的？
一旁，吴超幽幽地笑，他笑起来总是如此鬼魅，笑的有些阴冷。
“小朋友，看来我可以解放了！在这之前，猎魔小队上一任诱饵死了之后，一直都是我兼任，我还真怕哪天我死了，现在看来……有人接班了！”
感情上一任是他！
李皓也是无言。
当然，来之前，刘隆其实就说的明白，他就是诱饵。
只是，现在正式确定了而已。
下一刻，刘隆看了看李皓，微微皱眉道：“当然，我让你当诱饵，不是让你去送死！你这身板，看样子实力不怎么样，哪怕修炼了猿术，时间太短，也不会有太大建树！”
说罢，迈步朝那些健身器材走去：“来，试验一下你的本事！让我心中有个数，接下来看怎么培训你，也顺便看看，你有没有把握从超能者手中逃生。”
李皓没说什么，跟了上去。
其他人也很好奇，纷纷跟上。
柳艳嘴巴都快贴到李皓耳朵上了，轻声细语地笑道：“拿出全部本事来，在这，别藏着！你太弱，藏也没有必要，藏拙只会让你收获小，老大手头上还是有些好东西的！”

李皓没说什么，只是避开了对方的嘴巴，别对我耳朵吹气，难受。
“咯咯咯……”
柳艳笑的开心，前方，刘隆也不管这个。
倒是身旁，另外一位女性成员，那位医生云瑶轻笑道：“艳姐，别逗他了。”
“谁逗他了？”
柳艳笑靥如花，“小皓多好看，你看看咱们队，歪瓜裂枣的！瘦的如竹竿，胖的像堵墙，队长倒是还行，可年纪大了不说，皮肤也黑漆漆的，跟个黑煤球似的！还是小皓好看！”
其他三位男人，脚步都是微微一滞。
没人说什么。
可李皓觉得，自己很无辜，他好像一下子得罪了三个人。
我可没说这些，都是柳艳说的，你们可别记仇到我头上。
此刻，众人已经到了健身区。
什么器材都有！
刘隆也不管刚刚的事，声音如一：“在进入超凡领域之前，人类也有实力强大的修炼者，比如你的老师袁硕，五禽术修炼到了极致，战力极强！”
“如上一任巡检司司长，一身铁布衣，也修炼到了极致，寻常刀剑难入，枪械也只能留下一些外伤。”
“这些人，都是凡俗领域，一门神功修炼到极致的代表！”
“在超凡出现之前，我们称呼这些人为武师！武术一道的大师、宗师，以凡俗肉身，抗衡热武器的代表！”
李皓认真聆听，这些，都是他之前不曾涉足的领域。
刘隆继续道：“武师也有强弱，当然，很多时候，不是单纯的力量区分！有人擅长速度，有人擅长防守，有人擅长力量……”
“各有所长，自然也不好放在一起区分！速度快的，也许可以杀死力量强，速度慢的武师！力量强的，也有可能一拳打死速度快的武师。”
“作为武师，总有一项突出的能力，超乎常人的能力，那才能叫武师！速度、力量是一种最直观的体现，其他如防守能力，比如陈坚这种，不到生死关头，其实很难权衡出他到底多厉害。”

李皓再次点头。
是这个理！
他看向刘隆，带着一些好奇：“队长的意思是，武师很难区分强弱？所以，所有武师，都差不多……”
“扯淡！”
“……”
李皓无言，你这么说的啊。
刘隆扭头看向他：“别想太多，强就是强，弱就是弱！所以，在十多年前，武师也有实力强弱的区分，只是区分层次不多，斩十、破百、斗千！这就是武师！”
李皓微微一怔，这……太直观了吧！
也太简单了吧！
刘隆好像知道他的意思，冷冷道：“一听就懂，是吗？就是这么直接！这里的人，指的是正规军中的军士水准！凡是能称上武师的人，最基本的要求，能在正面突破一支十人小队，斩杀他们，这就是斩十的水准！再往上，就是破百，难度超乎你想象，一直百人军队，你能一击之力击溃，你就是破百的强者！”
“至于斗千……”
刘隆深吸一口气：“只是理论上这么说罢了，实际上，凡夫俗子，你实力再强，遭遇一支千人军队，哪怕不用热武器，你也是死路一条！你的体力、精力都会在战斗中急速消耗，再强，也有极限，你根本不可能做到斗千！”
“直到超能出现，一些强大的超能者，才真正意义上具备了斗千的水平。”
李皓微微一怔，提出疑问：“队长的意思是，强大的超能者，才能如此，那是不是代表一些弱小的超能者，也许也就是斩十，破百的水平？”
“也就是？”
刘隆看着他，带着一些讥嘲：“也就？真等哪天，你试试就知道了！破百，以一敌百！速度、力量都达到了一个极致，这样的超能者，还有一些特殊能力，哪怕武师中的破百高手，遭遇对方，也是九死一生！你觉得很弱吗？”
李皓没说话。
破百……
听起来不难，实际上，对面真有一支百人小队，都是强悍的军士，李皓大概刚闯进去，就被人锤死了。
而此刻，李皓很好奇刘隆的实力。

“那队长……是破百的实力？”
刘隆一脸淡漠，柳艳笑着接话：“算是吧，勉强算是！老大不强，如何带着我们杀超能者！超能者还是很强的，哪怕最弱的，其实也有堪比破百的实力，而且更难缠！”
李皓这一次，才清晰地知道，这位队长到底有多强。
当然，只是字面上的知道，实际上多厉害……真没什么直观感受。
破百，听起来好像不咋地。
“那袁老师呢？”
“你的老师，巅峰期大概也具备破百战力，只是现在年老体衰，体力、速度都在下滑，恐怕不行了。”
刘隆微微摇头：“当初一部分顶级的武师，都达到了这个水平！只是这些年来，随着热武器强大起来，超能出现，大家追逐超能，已经很少有人能下苦心，再去修炼这些凡俗武道了！”
“引入神秘能，一步登天，体格强大，体能强化，原本只是普通人，一天后可能就堪比斩十的武师，过段时间就是破百的武道宗师！你说，还有多少人愿意去修炼古武？”
他看向李皓，叹息一声：“超能，就是打破人体极限，让人类突破自我，让上限无限提升，哪怕只是装了一点点水的木桶，装的水也比酒杯多！而凡俗武师，就是酒杯！超能，就是木桶！你能明白吗？”
李皓点头，明白。
的确很让人绝望！
凡俗武师，若是无法引入神秘能，成为超能者，那就算修炼一辈子，也无法打破极限，苦修多年，却是连一位刚入门的超能都斗不过，这得多绝望！
像袁硕，年幼习武，现在七十多了，体力在下滑，原本也是武师界的领袖人物，结果倒好，以前破百，现在可能只有斩十的实力。
这样的实力，在超能者那边，只是入门！
一个七十多岁的宗师级人物，也就和一些入门的小年轻比一比，难怪自己修炼五禽术的时候，袁老师只是说，多个保命的本事，强身健体罢了。
从未说过，这是杀人术！
因为现实太让人绝望！
而刘隆，简单介绍了一下，很快道：“你去试试，简单观察一下你的速度，力量，看看你有几分本事。”
听闻此言，李皓也不再说。

没有藏着，也没必要。
他这点猿术功底，恐怕真不放在这几位眼中。
场中，李皓如同猿猴一般，在整个健身区迅速跳跃翻滚，是不是猴拳一出，打的一些沙包不断弹射而出。
刘隆默默观察着。
瘦弱的吴超，看了一会，轻轻摇头：“比起一般人要强一些，和队里的一些老巡检其实也不差多少，只是这……老大，就他，能逃过超能追杀？”
胖墩墩的陈坚也闷闷道：“斩十的水平绝对没有，撑死了斩二斩三！咱们猎魔小队，这些年，第一次招收这么弱的家伙吧？”
遇到两三个军士，李皓这身本事也许有点用，能击杀对方。
可两三个和十个，其实差距不是三四倍，而是十倍以上的难度。
此刻的李皓，在他们看来太弱了。
柳艳抱着胳膊，看了一会，笑眯眯道：“养着，看着养眼也不错，做一些后勤、情报分析也行，人家是文职，又不是你们这些武夫！”
李皓是文职人员，早就该有准备的。
柳艳不觉得有什么问题。
众人一想，也是这个道理。
柳艳又道：“配备一些热武器，斩十很厉害吗？一炮下去，照样轰杀！当然，到了破百的层次，武师也好，超能也好，都很难对付了。”
主要是难以锁定，你眼睛看到了人，脑子发出指令，下一刻人家到了你跟前，一巴掌拍死了你，那再强的武器也没啥用了。
破百之下，其实热武器还是具备极其强大的杀伤力的。
有人牵制的话，破百，也不是不能被轰死。
刘隆也微微点头：“他肯定要携带热武器的，挑些好用的，顺手的，轻便的出来给他用！这家伙，脑子够用就行，至于身手……若是能杀个超能，给他引入一些神秘能，哪怕不能成为超能，强化一些体质、速度，破十也不是难事。”
说罢，又低声笑道：“关键是，这家伙……可不单单是个文职，还是古文字方面的专家，虽说肯定不如袁硕，可对我们而言，也许够用了！”
此话一出，几人都是若有所思，也是。

李皓，还是有不小用处的。
加入猎魔小队，好像也不错。
而此刻，正在快速跳跃的李皓，觉得自己还是不错的，起码比之前强不少了。
当他气喘吁吁地从场地中退出，有些喘气，带着一些期待道：“队长，你看，我和斩十的武师，有没有差距，能算破十吗？”
他觉得，自己现在有希望一个打十个的！
而刘隆迟疑了一下，也是难得有些窘迫，半晌没能接话，这小子，哪来的自信？
斩十，就这？
而其他人，也是面面相觑，人啊，果然没有自知之明！
你洗洗睡吧！
李皓也渐渐察觉到了不对，半晌，有些窘迫道：“斩九？”
“……”
几人都不吭声。
“斩五？”
“……”
依旧无声。
李皓脸色有些变化，不至于吧，我喝了泡剑水之后，觉得我已经很厉害了，甚至可以和袁老师打一架了，可袁老师是破百，我不至于差这么多吧？
袁老师只是猿术能打五个来回，十几分钟，我现在也能打9分钟啊！
许久，刘隆打破了沉默：“别想太多，不怕弱，就怕懒！好好干，斩十也就那样。”
“……”
再次无声。

李皓已经明白了，顿时有些无奈和悲哀，合着，我斩五的水平都没？
那我还一门心思去弄死红影，他么的，真是无知者无畏啊！
content_en:
Liu Yan did not take Li Hao to Liu Long's office.
Instead, he turned left and right, and finally entered the basement of the law enforcement building, a basement area that no one else could enter.
The place was very big. As soon as Li Hao entered, he felt a little empty, but very quiet.
The quietness is a bit breathtaking.
Being in a law enforcement building can still make people feel creepy. This place is obviously not ordinary.
In the entrance area, there is a large amount of exercise equipment.
The walls, like Liu Yan's office, also had a large number of weapons hanging on them.
There are both hot weapons and cold weapons.
Swords, guns, swords and halberds, everything is available.
As for thermal weapons, Li Hao even saw a large small artillery piece. Li Hao's scalp was really numb when he saw it. Oh my God, how many weapons have these guys hoarded?
The law enforcement team just has an advantage.
Even if Liu Long's place is investigated, it doesn't matter. He is the law enforcement captain and the boss of Yincheng's violent organization. If he said that these weapons are used to deal with gangsters, then no one can find fault.
If Li Hao dared to hoard so many weapons, he would have been caught and shot.
In front of the fitness area and weapons depot, there is a small passage that seems to lead to other areas.
Liu Yan did not take Li Hao in.
Entering the fitness area, Liu Yan shouted loudly: "Boss, people are here!"
After a while, several figures walked out from the depths.
Liu Long was tall and tall, Wu Chao was as thin as a bamboo pole, a fat man who was shaking when he walked, and a petite, kind-looking woman who was not too old.
Including Liu Yan, there are exactly five people.
This is the demon hunting team of the law enforcement team.
Although this season is very hot, Liu Long still wears a windbreaker. Most of the reason is to cover up the weapons hanging all over his body. Otherwise, anyone can see the problem if he goes out with so many weapons.
"Liu Long!"
Liu Long stepped over, and before the cold expression on his face remained, he introduced himself again: "Captain of the Demon Hunting Team, responsible for frontal attack!"
Wu Chao, who was wearing a thin flagpole, also smiled faintly: "Wu Chao, the investigator of the demon hunting team, is responsible for intelligence search and side-drawing firepower!"
The astonishingly fat man with a thick and thick voice also introduced himself: "Chen Jian, the shield defender of the Demon Hunting Team, responsible for the defense!"
The petite woman's voice was also very soft, "Yun Yao, the doctor of the demon hunting team, is responsible for the treatment."
Four people, different positions, different functions.
The division of labor is clear!
Although there are few people, they have all five organs.
Li Hao glanced at Liu Yan, what is this person responsible for?
Liu Yanqiao smiled like smoke. When she saw Li Hao looking at him, she smiled sweetly and said: "What are you looking at? Liu Yan, the deputy captain of the demon hunting team, the deputy attacker! The boss is the main attacker, and I am responsible for the last hit!"
Li Hao understood.
Liu Long looked at Li Hao and said calmly: "We are all the members of the demon hunting team! There used to be more people, but now... there are a lot less, just a few of us!"
"Now, the team only has two main attackers and two assistant attackers, and one doctor, one shield defender, and one scout each."
He looked at Li Hao and said in a deep voice: "Li Hao, are you willing to join us?"
Li Hao nodded.
Liu Long looked at him deeply, "Li Hao, do you know why we are called the Demon Hunting Team?"
Li Hao said nothing.
Liu Long asked himself and answered, "Because... we are justice!"
At this moment, Li Hao was even in a trance. Looking at the people in front of him, are we...just?
Liu Long's voice was cold, but there was no doubt about it: "We are justice! Maybe we have our own purposes and thoughts, but don't forget, we are the law enforcement team of the Inspection Department! We are a law enforcement agency, we uphold justice, and we protect Yincheng. Everything we do is to protect and strengthen ourselves on the one hand, and on the other hand we are also maintaining peace!"
"The demons we hunt are all executioners who disturb the mortal world and whose hands are stained with blood!"
"Li Hao, join us, the first thingJust forget about other things and remember one thing, we are righteous! And those superpowers who make mistakes are demons, but the night watchman cannot clean them up, so we are responsible for cleaning up the filth! "
As soon as he joined the demon hunting team, Liu Long began to instill the team's mission into Li Hao.
In other words, this is the team seal of the demon hunting team!
A team with different agendas is obviously extremely dangerous to them, because the enemies they deal with are beyond imagination.
Therefore, this small team actually has its own beliefs or beliefs.
Justice is served!
Regardless of whether it is true or false, they all firmly believe that they are messengers of justice and are driving away demons from Silver City.
"Justice..."
Li Hao murmured.
Liu Long's voice was extremely serious: "Not bad! justice! Li Hao suffered countless injuries and became the back garden of many superpowers, who could take whatever they wanted! "
"Of course, at this moment, you may not take it seriously or believe it! However, if you go out and take a walk, you will see that there are hundreds of thousands of cities in this huge world. Now, except for the central part, all directions are already in chaos. Chaos has arrived, and human lives are like ants! "
"When a supernatural being appears, cholera may spread throughout the city! But I, Yincheng, have been living and working in peace and contentment over the past few years. Although there have been riots, it has always been peaceful! The Demon Hunting Team has been established for five years, hunting five superpowers, one person every year, and saving Silver City every time! "
Liu Yan stood next to Li Hao, folding her arms, and said with a smile: "The boss is right, although the boss likes to brag, but what he said is true! We all have our own reasons for joining the demon hunting team. Maybe the original purpose was not to protect anyone, but that is the fact. Because of our existence, Silver City can live and work in peace and contentment! "
Li Hao was thoughtful.
Maybe what Liu Long said was not wrong.
They hunted superpowers, maybe to make themselves super. In fact, they may have also hunted some superpowers who were preparing for Cholera Silver City.
Is it a mess outside?
Li Hao doesn't know.
Because he has almost never left Yincheng. To say almost, that is because he has been to the city next door once before, but it was also many years ago.
"Li Hao, this is the first lesson I will teach you when you join the team! "
Liu Long's tone was solemn: "Don't think that we are ghosts who act in secret. You are wrong. We are law enforcers, envoys who safeguard and uphold justice! Therefore, for us, anyone who makes mistakes is a devil! Demon hunting, hunting demons, these are the demons you hunt! "
After hearing this, Li Hao suddenly felt a little relaxed.
Even Liu Long's words were a bit boastful and a bit self-defeating.
However, when Liu Long said that we are the justice and the law enforcers, Li Hao suddenly felt... very comfortable.
I just feel inexplicably comfortable!
We are not insidious people who act in secret, we are the guardians of the entire city. Although this may not be the original intention, the fact is here.
At this moment, Li Hao felt more and more that Liu Long was a master.
Not only is he top-notch in terms of strength and mentality, but the key is that the other party is also very capable in terms of ideological guidance.
He made every member of the demon hunting team believe that everything they did was just.
No guilt!
Even if you kill a superpower, you will only feel that you have accomplished something, protecting the people, protecting justice, and protecting the Silver City.
This kind of psychological satisfaction is something that ordinary leaders cannot achieve.
And Liu Long actually made achievements in this area.
At this moment, Li Hao felt that joining the demon hunting team might be a good choice.
At this moment, Liu Long said in a deep voice: "Li Hao, introduce yourself! "
Li Hao thought for a while and said: "My name is Li Hao. I was inspected by the former Confidential Office and expelled students from Yincheng Ancient Academy! I am good at the Ape Technique among the Five Animal Techniques, and my movements are relatively agile. "
"No more? "
Liu Long looked at him, and Li Hao was a little embarrassed: "No. "
Liu Long said coldly: "That's it, you become Yuan ShuoClose disciple? "
Li Hao was a little embarrassed: "That's a compliment from the teacher. "
"Li Hao, here, if you are not valuable enough and are in danger, we will not give up on you, but we will not risk our lives to rescue you! If you are valuable enough, even if we sacrifice, we will keep you alive, so that our faith will continue! "
Li Hao was silent for a while and then added: "I am also good at analyzing ancient characters. In the exploration of ancient civilizations, analysis of ancient characters is an important part. I have a strong memory, which is one of my strengths. "
Several people looked at me and I looked at you with strange eyes.
Analysis of ancient texts!
Is it useful?
Very useful!
Yuan Shuo has a high status now just because he is the director of the Department of Ancient Civilization Exploration. His identity is not the key. The key is that Yuan Shuo is also a senior expert in ancient civilization and his research on ancient civilization is extremely in-depth.
Therefore, even the night watchman relies on him.
However, the night watchman did not dare to let Yuan Shuo become a superpower, because once Yuan Shuo became a superpower, there would be a lot of trouble.
Some things are useless to ordinary people, but they are very useful to superpowers.
But often, superpowers don't have enough knowledge and insights to identify things that are useful to them.
Yuan Shuo can do it!
Yuan Shuo, an ordinary person, dare not hide or embezzle.
But once Yuan Shuo becomes a superpower, he will probably be out of control. Once he discovers some treasures, he will most likely steal them for himself, and he will do so without anyone knowing.
At this moment, Liu Long's eyes lit up slightly!
"How much of Yuan Shuo's true biography have you obtained? "
Li Hao said modestly: "The captain overestimated me. The teacher's knowledge is as vast as the sea, and I just absorbed a drop of it. "
"Speak humanly! "
"..."
Li Hao had no choice but to say: "I only followed the teacher in Guyuan for two years, mainly studying and not participating in any practice. The teacher is good at too many things. Now I only study some ancient text analysis, and my other abilities are far inferior to the teacher. The teacher is good at too many things, such as trap cracking, antiquities preservation, Feng Shui positioning, ancient civilization and humanities..."
Speaking of Yuan Shuo, Li Hao was filled with emotion and couldn't match him. He sighed: "After I left the ancient courtyard, I was busy with other things and had no time to study. The teacher's ability is really beyond my reach! "
Liu Long said in a deep voice: "It's already very good! Being favored by Yuan Shuo represents your talent and ability! "
Analysis of ancient characters...
He didn't say any more about this and quickly said: "Okay, Li Hao, from today on, you will be the intelligence analyst and... bait of the demon hunting team! "
"..."
There was silence.
Bait can also work part-time?
On the side, Wu Chao smiled faintly. His smile was always so ghostly, and his smile was a little cold.
"Kid, it seems I can be liberated! Before this, after the last Bait of the Demon Hunting Team died, I was always in charge of it. I was really afraid that one day I would die, but now it seems... someone has taken over! "
My last relationship was him!
Li Hao was also speechless.
Of course, before coming, Liu Long actually made it clear that he was the bait.
It’s just that it’s officially confirmed now.
The next moment, Liu Long looked at Li Hao, frowned slightly and said: "Of course, I asked you to be a bait, not to send you to death! With your body, you don't seem to have much strength. Even if you practice the ape technique, you won't achieve much in a short period of time! "
After that, he walked towards the fitness equipment: "Come on, test your skills! Let me have an idea in my mind. Next, I will see how to train you. I will also see if you are confident of escaping from the hands of superpowers. "
Li Hao didn't say anything and followed him.
Others were also curious and followed suit.
Liu Yan's mouth almost touched Li Hao's ear, and she whispered with a smile: "Use all your skills, here, don't hide it! You are too weak, there is no need to hide, hiding your clumsiness will only make youThe harvest is small, but the boss still has some good things on hand! "
Li Hao didn't say anything, he just avoided the other person's mouth. Don't blow into my ears. It's uncomfortable.
"Kekeke..."
Liu Yan smiled happily. Liu Long didn't care about the situation ahead.
Next to him, another female member, the doctor Yunyao, chuckled and said: "Sister Yan, stop teasing him. "
"Who teased him? "
Liu Yan's smile was as bright as a flower, "Xiao Hao is so good-looking, look at our team, it's so messed up! As thin as a bamboo pole and as fat as a wall, the captain is not bad, but despite his age, his skin is as dark as a black briquette! Xiao Hao is still pretty! "
The other three men's steps were slightly stagnant.
No one said anything.
But Li Hao felt that he was innocent. He seemed to have offended three people at once.
I didn't say this, it was Liu Yan who said it. Don't hold grudges against me.
At this moment, everyone has arrived at the fitness area.
All equipment is available!
Liu Long didn't care about what happened just now, his voice was the same: "Before entering the extraordinary realm, humans also had powerful practitioners, such as your teacher Yuan Shuo, who has practiced the Five Animal Technique to the extreme and is extremely powerful! "
"For example, the previous director of the Inspection Department was dressed in iron cloth and had practiced to the extreme. Ordinary swords and swords were difficult to penetrate, and firearms could only leave some external injuries. "
“These people are all representatives of the mortal realm and have practiced a magical skill to the extreme! "
"Before the extraordinary appeared, we called these people martial artists! The master and grandmaster of martial arts uses his mortal body to fight against the representatives of hot weapons! "
Li Hao listened carefully. These were areas he had never set foot in before.
Liu Long continued: "Martial masters also have strengths and weaknesses. Of course, in many cases, it is not just a matter of strength! Some are good at speed, some are good at defense, some are good at strength..."
“Each has its own strengths, so naturally it’s not easy to distinguish them together! A fast one may be able to kill a stronger but slower martial artist! Those with strong strength may even be able to kill a fast martial artist with one punch. "
"As a martial artist, you always have an outstanding ability that is beyond ordinary people's abilities. Only then can you be called a martial artist! Speed ​​and strength are the most intuitive manifestations. Others, such as defensive ability, such as Chen Jian's, are actually difficult to measure how powerful he is until the moment of life and death. "
Li Hao nodded again.
That’s the truth!
He looked at Liu Long with some curiosity: "Captain, you mean that it is difficult for a martial artist to distinguish between strong and weak? Therefore, all martial arts masters are similar..."
"Nonsense! "
"..."
Li Hao was speechless, you said so.
Liu Long turned to look at him: "Don't think too much, strong is strong, weak is weak! Therefore, more than ten years ago, martial arts masters also had strong and weak distinctions, but there were not many levels of distinction. They could kill ten, break a hundred, or fight a thousand! This is the martial artist! "
Li Hao was slightly startled. This... is so intuitive!
It’s too simple!
Liu Long seemed to know what he meant, and said coldly: "You will understand it as soon as you hear it, right? It’s so direct! The people here refer to the level of sergeants in the regular army! The most basic requirement for anyone who can be called a martial artist is to be able to break through a team of ten people from the front and kill them. This is the level of killing ten! Further up, there is breaking through a hundred. The difficulty is beyond your imagination. If you can defeat an army of hundreds of people with one blow, you are a strong person who can break through a hundred! "
"As for Dou Qian..."
Liu Long took a deep breath: "That's just in theory. In fact, ordinary people, no matter how strong you are, if you encounter an army of a thousand people, even if you don't use thermal weapons, you will die! Your physical strength and energy will be rapidly depleted in battle. No matter how strong you are, there is a limit. It is impossible for you to fight against thousands of people! "
“It wasn’t until superpowers appeared that some powerful superpowers truly reached the level of Dou Qian. "
Li Hao was slightly startled and asked: "What the captain means is that only a powerful super person can do this.Does that represent some weak superpowers, maybe at the level of cutting ten or breaking a hundred? "
"That is? "
Liu Long looked at him with some sarcasm: "That's it? I can’t wait to see if you try it one day! Break a hundred, one against a hundred! The speed and strength have reached an extreme level. Such superpowers also have some special abilities. Even a master with over 100 martial arts skills will have a narrow escape from death when encountering the opponent! Do you feel weak? "
Li Hao said nothing.
Breaking a hundred...
It doesn't sound difficult. In fact, there was a team of a hundred people on the opposite side, all of them were strong sergeants. Li Hao probably was hammered to death as soon as he broke in.
At this moment, Li Hao was very curious about Liu Long's strength.
"Then captain...is the strength that exceeds 100? "
Liu Long looked indifferent, and Liu Yan answered with a smile: "That's right, barely! If the boss is not strong, how can he lead us to kill superpowers! Superpowers are still very strong. Even the weakest ones are actually as strong as over a hundred, and they are even more difficult to deal with! "
This time, Li Hao clearly understood how strong this captain was.
Of course, I only know it literally, but I don’t really have an intuitive feeling about how powerful it is actually.
Breaking 100 doesn't sound like a good deal.
"What about Teacher Yuan? "
"Your teacher probably had over 100 combat powers at his peak, but now he is old and frail, and his physical strength and speed are declining. I'm afraid he won't be able to survive. "
Liu Long shook his head slightly: "Some of the top martial arts masters back then have reached this level! It's just that over the years, as thermal weapons have become more powerful, superpowers have emerged, and everyone is chasing superpowers, few people can take the pains to practice these ordinary martial arts! "
"Introducing mysterious energy, one can reach the sky in one step, with a powerful physique and strengthened physical abilities. He was just an ordinary person in the beginning, but one day later he may be comparable to a martial artist who has killed ten people, and after a while he has become a martial arts master who has exceeded one hundred! Tell me, how many people are still willing to practice ancient martial arts? "
He looked at Li Hao and sighed: "Superpower means breaking the limits of the human body, allowing humans to break through themselves, and infinitely increase the upper limit. Even a wooden barrel filled with a little water can hold more water than a wine glass! And the ordinary martial artist is the wine glass! The super power is the barrel! Can you understand? "
Li Hao nodded, understanding.
It’s really disappointing!
If an ordinary martial artist cannot introduce mysterious energy and become a superpower, then even if he practices for a lifetime, he will not be able to break the limit. After years of hard training, he cannot even defeat a new superpower. How hopeless this is!
Take Yuan Shuo, who practiced martial arts at a young age. Now he is over seventy, and his physical strength is declining. He was originally a leader in the martial arts world, but the results are not good. He used to break through a hundred, but now he may only have the strength to kill ten.
Such strength is just an entry point for superpowers!
A master-level figure in his seventies can only compare with some young people who are just starting out. No wonder when he practiced the Five Animals Technique, Teacher Yuan only said that it was a matter of life-saving skills and physical fitness.
I never said it was a killing technique!
Because the reality is so disappointing!
Liu Long, on the other hand, gave a brief introduction and quickly said: "Go and give it a try, simply observe your speed and strength, and see how capable you are. "
After hearing this, Li Hao stopped talking.
There is no need to hide it.
His ape skills are probably not in the eyes of these people.
In the field, Li Hao was like an ape, jumping and rolling rapidly throughout the fitness area. When he punched out his monkey punch, some of the sandbags he hit kept ejecting.
Liu Long observed silently.
The thin Wu Chao looked at it for a while and shook his head slightly: "He is stronger than ordinary people, and he is not much different from some of the old patrols in the team. It's just that... the boss, just him, can he escape the superpower's pursuit? "
The chubby Chen Jian also said gloomily: "The level of Zhan Shi is definitely not the best. I can kill two and chop three!" Is this the first time in these years that our demon hunting team has recruited such a weak guy? "
When Li Hao met two or three sergeants, heHis own abilities may be of some use and he can kill the opponent.
But the difference between two or three and ten is actually not three or four times, but more than ten times more difficult.
At this moment, Li Hao was too weak in their opinion.
Liu Yan crossed her arms, looked at it for a while, and said with a smile: "Keep it, it's good for your eyes, and you can also do some logistics and intelligence analysis. I'm a civilian, not a warrior like you!"
Li Hao is a civilian employee and should have been prepared long ago.
Liu Yan didn't think there was any problem.
When everyone thinks about it, this is also true.
Liu Yan added: "With some thermal weapons, is it very powerful to kill ten? One shot will still kill you! Of course, when it reaches the level of breaking a hundred, it will be difficult to deal with it, whether it is a martial artist or a superpower."
The main reason is that it is difficult to lock on. Your eyes see the person and your brain issues instructions. The next moment they come to you and slap you to death. No matter how powerful the weapon is, it is useless.
At over 100, thermal weapons are actually extremely lethal.
If someone restrains him, even if he breaks a hundred, he won't be bombarded to death.
Liu Long also nodded slightly: "He must carry a thermal weapon. Pick something easy to use, easy to use, and light for him to use! This guy only needs enough brains. As for his skills... If he can kill a super power, introduce some mysterious powers to him. Even if he can't become a super power, it will not be difficult to strengthen some physical fitness and speed. It will not be difficult to break ten."
After that, he laughed softly and said: "The key is that this guy... is not only a civil servant, but also an expert in ancient writing. Although he is definitely not as good as Yuan Shuo, he may be enough for us!"
As soon as these words came out, several people were thoughtful, too.
Li Hao is still of great use.
Joining the demon hunting team seems like a good idea.
At this moment, Li Hao, who was jumping quickly, felt that he was still pretty good, at least much better than before.
When he exited the venue out of breath, panting a little, he said with some expectation: "Captain, look, is there a gap between me and the martial artist who cuts ten? Can it be counted as breaking ten?"
He felt that he now had hope of beating ten of them!
Liu Long hesitated for a moment, feeling a little embarrassed. He couldn't answer for a while. Where does this kid get his confidence?
Cut ten, that’s it?
The others also looked at each other in confusion. People really don’t know themselves!
Just wash up and go to sleep!
Li Hao also gradually realized something was wrong. After a while, he said in embarrassment: "Zhan Jiu?"
"..."
Several people were silent.
"Cut five?"
"..."
Still silent.
Li Hao's expression changed a little. Isn't it serious? After I drank the sword soaking water, I felt that I was already very powerful and could even fight with Teacher Yuan. But Teacher Yuan was over 100, so I wouldn't be so far behind, right?
Teacher Yuan can only perform five rounds of ape technique, which lasts for ten minutes. Now I can perform it for nine minutes!
After a long time, Liu Long broke the silence: "Don't think too much, don't be afraid of weakness, just be afraid of laziness! Work hard, and it will be like that."
"..."
Silence again.
Li Hao already understood, and suddenly felt helpless and sad. Co-author, I am not even good at cutting five?
Then I am still focused on killing Hong Ying, what the hell, the ignorant are really fearless!
